newsitem.title: USA: Ahmanson sees Q1 EPS at $0.75 or more.
newsitem.headline: Ahmanson sees Q1 EPS at $0.75 or more.

text.p: H.F. Ahmanson and Co Chairman and Chief Executive Charles Rinehart said Monday that based on results for the first two months of the year, first quarter earnings are likely to be $0.75 per share or more.
He also told analysts that full-year earnings are likely to top analysts' estimates by five to 15 percent.
According to First Call, the consensus estimate for Ahmanson for the first quarter is $0.70 per share, and the consensus for the full year is $2.96 per share.

Rinehart said Ahmanson expects credit costs in the first quarter to decline to $50 million from $58 million in the 1996 fourth quarter. He said he was assuming credit costs would be "normal" for the month of March.
On the revenue side, he said Ahmanson is seeing "continued growth in consumer loans, investment products and fee income."
In the year-ago first quarter Ahmanson earned $0.45 per fully diluted common share. For the full year 1996 it earned $2.21 per share before special charges that reduced net earnings to $0.91 a share.
